title: Anthropic Computer Use on Windows with a LangChain Agent
summary: Cameron Rohn moves Anthropic Computer Use out of Docker onto Windows and adds a LangChain agent.
learn: Computer Use breaks into three tools; the computer tool takes screenshots and tries to locate pixel coordinates.
He found the bash and command line tools the most useful, and says full file system access is powerful.
His agent has the computer tools plus several overlapping web search tools.
Demo: asking the agent to create and update a page in an Obsidian notebook, with the file path spelled out.
Microsoft OmniParser does OCR of your screen and creates attributes agents can reference.
